Q: track keyword google ranking in python A: 
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
import threading
import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.common.action_chains import ActionChains
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium_stealth import stealth
import undetected_chromedriver as uc
import random
import json
from flask_limiter import Limiter
from flask_limiter.util import get_remote_address
from twocaptcha import TwoCaptcha
import re


solver = TwoCaptcha('API_KEY')


app = Flask(__name__)

limiter = Limiter(get_remote_address, app=app, default_limits=["5 per minute"])

semaphore = threading.Semaphore(3)

def find_rank(domain, keyword, max_results=100):
    with semaphore:
        try:
            options = uc.ChromeOptions()
            options.add_argument("--headless=new")
            options.add_argument("--use-subprocess")
            options.add_argument("--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled")
            options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
            options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
            options.add_argument("--user-agent=Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")

            driver = uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=144, use_subprocess=True)

            stealth(driver,
                    languages=["en-US", "en"],
                    vendor="Google Inc.",
                    platform="Win32",
                    webgl_vendor="Intel Inc.",
                    renderer="Intel Iris OpenGL Engine",
                    fix_hairline=True,)
            
            driver.get("https://www.google.com")
            time.sleep(10)


            with open("cookies.json", "r") as f:
                cookies = json.load(f)
                for cookie in cookies:
                    if "expiry" in cookie:
                        cookie["expires"] = cookie.pop("expiry")
                    if "domain" in cookie:
                        cookie["domain"] = ".google.com"
                    try:
                        driver.add_cookie(cookie)
                    except:
                        continue
            driver.refresh()
            time.sleep(random.uniform(8, 12))


            url = f"https://www.google.com/search?q={keyword.replace(' ', '+')}&num={max_results}"
            driver.get(url)
            time.sleep(25)


            for i in range(4):
                scroll_percent = 0.25 * (i + 1)
                driver.execute_script(f"window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight * {scroll_percent});")
                time.sleep(random.uniform(1.5, 3.5))

            ActionChains(driver).move_by_offset(random.randint(90, 240), random.randint(90, 210)).perform()
            time.sleep(3)

            response_text = driver.page_source
            page_title = driver.title

            if 'recaptcha' in response_text.lower() or 'captcha' in response_text.lower():
                print("Captcha detected - solving with 2Captcha...")
                sitekey = re.search(r'data-sitekey="([^"]+)"', response_text).group(1)
                captcha_url = driver.current_url

                result = solver.recaptcha(sitekey=sitekey, url=captcha_url)
                code = result['code']

                driver.execute_script(f'document.getElementById("g-recaptcha-response").innerHTML = "{code}";')
                time.sleep(2)

                try:
                    driver.find_element(By.ID, 'recaptcha-submit').click()
                except:
                    pass

                time.sleep(10)
                response_text = driver.page_source

                if 'captcha' in response_text.lower():
                    return {"status": "captcha_solve_failed", "rank": None, "checked_results": 0, "found_url": None}

            debug_file = f"debug_{keyword.replace(' ', '_')}_{int(time.time())}.html"
            with open(debug_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(response_text)
            
            
            if any(x in response_text.lower() for x in ["captcha", "recaptcha", "unusual traffic", "our systems have detected"]):
                return {"status": "captcha_detected", "rank": None, "checked_results": 0, "found_url": None}


            soup = BeautifulSoup(response_text, 'html.parser')
            results = soup.select('#rso > div, #rso div.MjjYud, #rso div.g, div.yuRUbf, div.tF2Cxc, div[data-hveid]')

            rank = 1
            checked = 0
            found_url = None


            for result in results:
                link = result.select_one("a[href]")
                if not link or 'href' not in link.attrs:
                    continue

                href = link['href']
                if href.startswith('/url?'):
                    from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
                    q = parse_qs(urlparse(href).query).get('q', [None])[0]
                    if q:
                        href = q
                
                if (
                    result.select_one('.uVMCKf')
                    or "ad" in href.lower()
                    or "googleads" in href.lower()
                    or result.get("data-text-ad")
                    or "commercial" in "".join(result.get("class", []))
                    or result.select_one(".commercialUnitDesktopTop")
                    or result.select_one(".commercialUnitDesktopBottom")
                ):
                    continue

                if domain.lower() in href.lower():
                    found_url = href
                    driver.quit()
                    return {"status": "ok", "rank": rank, "checked_results": checked + 1, "found_url": found_url}
                    
                rank += 1
                checked += 1
                if checked >= max_results:
                    break
            
            return {"status": "not_found", "rank": None, "checked_results": checked, "found_url": None}
        
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error in find_rank: {e}")
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            return {"status": "error", "rank": None, "checked_results": 0, "found_url": None, "error": str(e)}
        
        finally:
            if driver is not None:
                try:
                    driver.quit()
                except Exception as quit_e:
                    print(f"Ignoring quit error: {quit_e}")
                    pass
    

@app.route('/api/rank', methods=['POST'])
@limiter.limit("1 per 5 second")
def get_rank():
    data = request.json
    if not data or 'domain' not in data or 'keyword' not in data:
        return jsonify({"status": "bad_request"}), 400
    
    domain = data['domain']
    keyword = data['keyword']
    max_results = data.get('max_results', 100)

    time.sleep(5)

    result = find_rank(domain, keyword, max_results)
    result['domain'] = domain
    result['keyword'] = keyword
    return jsonify(result)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(threaded=True, port=5000)

I considered the Google API_KEY-free mode. I went ahead with the scraping method and took help from the 2Captcha site to avoid captcha.

Q: PlatformException(VideoError, Video player had error com.google.android.exoplayer2.ExoPlaybackException: Source error, null, null) A:

This problem is with latest SDK of Flutter with ExoPlayer. This exception will only be thrown on Android Devices with Android version 10. Video will not play.

Solution 1

If you try the Flutter SDK 3.23, you will not face this exception. But in 2026 the Flutter SDK 3.23 is very old. So the only option is either ignore Android Version 10 Users, or…

Solution 2

There is a package on Pub dev named as Flutter VLC player. It will play video anywhere, but it’s integration is hard, and it will put more than 60+ MB on your app size.

Final Solution (Recommended)

Go to MainActivity. Make a video player in Kotlin and communicate it with Flutter. That’s the only fix currently. Since I have checked this issue up to Flutter SDK 3.35, and it hasn’t been solved yet. So just communicate with Kotlin, since it’s an Android single-version issue.

Note: ExoPlayer throws quite similar errors for all kinds of video player exception, so check if your problem is with an Android 10 device, then the mentioned solutions will work 100% and there is no other solution currently. For other problems, ignore this.

Q: Why does SSMS tell me to run 'ssms.exe /resetsetting' when I open it? A:

"Try navigating to the actual SSMS install directory in command prompt (usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft SQL Server\[version]\Tools\Binn\ManagementStudio) and run ssms.exe /resetsettings from there—the command needs to be run from the right folder. If that still doesn't work, the Microsoft fix-it tool for install/uninstall issues or deleting the Ssms.CTM file in your user AppData folder (like mentioned in the third answer) might do the trick! 🛠️"

Q: How to load native libraries with a long path? A:

This is an unresolved bug: JDK-8348664 Enable long path support in manifest for java.exe and javaw.exe on Windows

Java exectuble is built without a necessary flag in manifest.

Q: Unable to include LibSodium libraries A:

The NuGet PM gets the packages in the project's root/Packages directory. I had to move the package from there to a directory in the Assets directory (/Assets/Plugins).

Q: Ceph faild to add osd node to a new ceph cluster (Error EINVAL: Traceback (most recent call last)) A:

The issue is related with this file: /sys/kernel/security/apparmor/profiles

Probably you have an entry like this: MongoDB Compass (unconfined)

Ceph uses a regular expression to split by space an get the confinement state. So this case with two spaces fails.

Try the following:

sudo grep -E '.*\s+\.*\s+.*' /sys/kernel/security/apparmor/profiles

You'll get the entries that makes ceph to fail.

Then, remove them using apparmor by looking the found entries inside the directory: /etc/apparmor.d. For example, for MongoDB Compass:

sudo apparmor_parser -R /etc/apparmor.d/MongoDB_Compass
